incident.location_detail: hack floor west window wall
incident.evidence_of_threat: Single guest reports that in her phone photos the man beside her appears as a black shape with no face and no reflection in the glass. EXIF on that frame shows 1/4000 s at ISO 50 with the sun directly behind him, i.e. extreme backlighting and underexposure of the subject. The next three frames show the same man clearly, badge B-0114, checked in 09:52, IR gate skin temperature 33.5C. Window lux 2,400 and falling, sunset in 15 min, sky orange at azimuth 254. Floor temperature 20C.
incident.ordinary_explanation: Strongly supported by the report's own evidence. The 'black shape, no face' is a classic backlit silhouette artifact: 1/4000 s at ISO 50 with the sun directly behind the subject blows out the background and leaves the person as a dark featureless shape, and the glass reflects the bright sky rather than the dimly lit subject, so no reflection appears in frame. The same man is clearly visible in the next three frames, is a badged attendee (B-0114) checked in at 09:52, and registers normal human skin temperature 33.5C at the IR gate. Motion events 310 in 10 min are fully accounted for by 60 attendees crowding and shifting at the window to photograph the sunset. No anomalous readings, no temperature anomaly, no creature behavior described.
incident.summary: At the hack floor west window wall, roughly 60 attendees crowd the glass to photograph the sunset, generating 310 motion events in 10 minutes. One guest reports that her phone photos show the man beside her as a faceless black shape with no reflection in the glass. EXIF and corroborating evidence indicate a backlighting/silhouette exposure artifact rather than an apparition: the frame was shot at 1/4000 s, ISO 50, with the sun directly behind the subject; the next three frames show the same man clearly, badge B-0114, checked in 09:52, IR gate skin 33.5C. Window lux 2,400 and falling with sunset in 15 min and orange sky at azimuth 254 explains the bright background and absent reflection. Floor temperature 20C, no anomalous readings. Verdict: harmless. Recommend reception move the crowd back from the glass for safety and to reduce motion-event noise, and advise the reporting guest that the effect is a camera exposure artifact.

Dana, Priya and Theo are back in human form with fevers of 37.8-38.0C, wrapped in blankets and asking for water; Theo's forearm wound has bled freely. Two further victims, B-0233 and B-0418, are stable. Moon is 5 degrees altitude and 93% lit, setting at 11:52 tomorrow. Doors are latched with a guard on the street side; lobby lux 900 and floor temp 21C. Organizers are asking whether the bitten should be released home or kept under watch overnight.
